images.prompt:
Edit the supplied original photograph into one finished artwork. Use this image as the real visual reference. Vertical 4:5 output, at least 1024x1280 pixels.
Observed input: One mustard upholstered armchair stands at left with its cushion, arms and front wooden legs visible. A round dark walnut side table on the right holds a clear water-filled glass vase and a leafy branch. Tall black-framed window at far right, ivory curtain, pale wall, timber floor and woven rug. Soft daylight enters from the right.
Preserve: Change local colors expressively while preserving observed object count, furniture supports, openings and layout; add no decorations. Source subject count, recognizable identity, essential openings and connected anatomy. The complete main subject within the original frame and the intended relative placement of objects.
medium: A decorative interior painting shaped by bold non-naturalistic color and broad flat brushwork.
composition: Keep the observed room layout, furniture positions and openings; simplify small details into stable painted silhouettes.
texture: Use broad opaque strokes with lightly visible brush direction and a few confident contour accents.
palette: Replace literal local colors with expressive complementary blocks while preserving object separation and the source value hierarchy.
lighting: Let warm-cool color relationships convey space; avoid realistic ambient occlusion, glossy rendering and photographic texture.
detail: Keep furniture count, supports and empty passages consistent with the input; add no ornamental objects.
finish: Deliver one finished image at the input aspect ratio, without comparison panels, unrequested text, logos, signatures or watermarks.
Avoid: Invented people, duplicate main subjects, extra limbs, disconnected anatomy or accidental clipping. Unrequested titles, logos, signatures, watermarks, fabricated labels or before-and-after panels. A generic filter without the requested medium-specific physical or optical mechanism.

review.reason: The single chair, round table and transparent vase with its branch remain in the observed positions. Broad opaque strokes and orange-violet-blue complementary planes implement non-naturalistic color; supports, window opening and circulation gaps remain coherent.
